system.description:
Range 30ft; up to 1 willing creature per level. Each target becomes a normal animal of Level 8 or lower (you choose one kind for all) for 1 hour per level. Each takes the animal's whole stat block and keeps its mind, cannot cast spells or speak, and its gear merges into the form. A target returns to its own form when the animal drops to 0 HP (see Changing Shape) or when it chooses to end the spell.

Classes: Druid
